entries.title: Psalms 69:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, [A Psalm] of David.>> Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto [my] soul.

entries.title: Psalms 69:2
segments: I sink in deep mire, where [there is] no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me. {deep mire: Heb. the mire of depth} {deep waters: Heb. depth of waters}

words.text: me. {deep mire: Heb. the mire of depth} {deep waters: Heb. depth of waters}

entries.title: Psalms 69:3
segments: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

entries.title: Psalms 69:4
segments: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, [being] mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored [that] which I took not away.

entries.title: Psalms 69:5
segments: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee. {sins: Heb. guiltiness}

entries.title: Psalms 69:6
segments: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

words.text: for my sake: let not those that seek

entries.title: Psalms 69:7
segments: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

words.text: Because for thy sake I have borne

entries.title: Psalms 69:8
segments: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

entries.title: Psalms 69:9
segments: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:10
segments: When I wept, [and chastened] my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 69:11
segments: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:12
segments: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I [was] the song of the drunkards. {drunkards: Heb. drinkers of strong drink}

words.text: against me; and I [was] the song

entries.title: Psalms 69:13
segments: ¶But as for me, my prayer [is] unto thee, O LORD, [in] an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 69:14
segments: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

words.text: me, and out of the deep

entries.title: Psalms 69:15
segments: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:16
segments: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness [is] good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

words.text: unto me according to the multitude

entries.title: Psalms 69:17
segments: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily. {hear...: Heb. make haste to hear me}

words.text: . {hear...: Heb. make haste to hear me}

entries.title: Psalms 69:18
segments: Draw nigh unto my soul, [and] redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 69:19
segments: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries [are] all before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 69:20
segments: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked [for some] to take pity, but [there was] none; and for comforters, but I found none. {to take...: Heb. to lament with me}

words.text: ; and I am full of heaviness
, but [there was] none; and for comforters
none. {to take...: Heb. to lament with me}

entries.title: Psalms 69:21
segments: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

entries.title: Psalms 69:22
segments: ¶Let their table become a snare before them: and [that which should have been] for [their] welfare, [let it become] a trap.

words.text: them: and [that which should have been] for [their] welfare

entries.title: Psalms 69:23
segments: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

entries.title: Psalms 69:24
segments: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

words.text: upon them, and let thy wrathful

entries.title: Psalms 69:25
segments: Let their habitation be desolate; [and] let none dwell in their tents. {their habitation: Heb. their palace} {let none...: Heb. let there not be a dweller}

words.text: . {their habitation: Heb. their palace} {let none...: Heb. let there not be a dweller}

entries.title: Psalms 69:26
segments: For they persecute [him] whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded. {those...: Heb. thy wounded}

words.text: of those whom thou hast wounded

entries.title: Psalms 69:27
segments: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness. {iniquity unto...: or, punishment of iniquity, etc}

words.text: . {iniquity unto...: or, punishment of iniquity, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 69:28
segments: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 69:29
segments: But I [am] poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

entries.title: Psalms 69:30
segments: ¶I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

entries.title: Psalms 69:31
segments: [This] also shall please the LORD better than an ox [or] bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

entries.title: Psalms 69:32
segments: The humble shall see [this, and] be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God. {humble: or, meek}

entries.title: Psalms 69:33
segments: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

entries.title: Psalms 69:34
segments: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein. {moveth: Heb. creepeth}

entries.title: Psalms 69:35
segments: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

words.text: there, and have it in possession

entries.title: Psalms 69:36
segments: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
